title: Section 148 BSA — Cross-examination as to previous statements in writing

content.heading: Cross-examination as to previous statements in writing
content.text: A witness may be cross-examined as to previous statements made by him in writing or reduced into writing, and relevant to matters in question, without such writing being shown to him or being proved; but, if it is intended to contradict him by the writing, his attention must, before the writing can be proved, be called to those parts of it which are to be used for the purpose of contradicting him. This is the successor of Evidence Act section 145.
